news.title: Ripple brings Wall Street into 24/7 stock bets, but HSBC warns markets are still thin
news.summary: Institutions can trade through Ripple Prime and post RLUSD as collateral. Finding enough buyers and sellers for large positions could prove harder.

news.title: Solana’s Alpenglow, its biggest network overhaul since 2020, goes live Wednesday
news.summary: Alpenglow will replace the voting system Solana has used since 2020, targeting roughly 150-millisecond finality after months of testing that included a failed migration and rollback.

news.title: A company that vouches for websites had secret keys so weak that 8 of them were cracked
news.summary: Eight secret keys at eMudhra, an Indian firm that vouches for websites, were compromised. Browsers and software makers are rushing out fixes.

news.title: Bitcoin hovers around $83,000 as AI earnings revive tech, ZEC jumps 11%
news.summary: Strong results from SpaceX and Super Micro sent Asian chip stocks surging, and ZEC led crypto higher after developers set a date for its next network upgrade.

news.title: U.S. CFTC sets agenda for AI forum, exploring trading and agentic finance
news.summary: A Commodity Futures Trading Commission task force is scheduled for October 28 to talk about how the latest "super intelligence" technology may impact markets.

news.title: OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo calls corporate objections a ‘natural response’ to tokenized stock plans
news.summary: The former NY governor, who co-chairs the joint venture between the crypto exchange and Intercontinental Exchange, said companies were expected to take a wait-and-see approach.

news.title: The Coinbase allegations expose Bitcoin's corporate governance gap
news.summary: Corporate adoption of bitcoin will stall as long as companies can't show who controls the money, who approves its movement, or whether it's still there, argues Onramp CEO Michael Tanguma.

news.title: BlackRock seeks to shield bitcoin investors from losses after rival fund weathers 50% crash
news.summary: BlackRock's proposed fund follows similar products from Calamos that helped investors avoid steep losses during bitcoin's selloff.

news.title: Bull markets tend to peak with a whimper, not a bang — but a 15% correction for the S&P 500 may be next
news.summary: Unlike bear-market bottoms, which typically end with a spasm of despair as traders throw in the towel, bull-market tops are far more gradual and less dramatic.

news.title: Super Micro’s stock soars after surprise update — with Dell and HPE shares joining the rally
news.summary: Super Micro unexpectedly disclosed that its revenue and profitability could be much stronger than originally anticipated.

news.title: Tesla’s stock rises as Elon Musk drops new clues about a possible SpaceX merger
news.summary: Special committees at both companies are assessing merger prospects but a combination is no sure thing, Musk says.

news.title: Netflix vows to revive viewership trends, but investors hit ‘sell’ on the stock
news.summary: Streaming service cites “intense competition’ and acknowledges ‘some investor concern about our view hours growth.”

news.title: Why SpaceX’s stock is surging — and lifting the broader AI universe along with it
news.summary: SpaceX just gave Wall Street a big reason to believe in the AI boom as demand for its computing power is off the charts.

news.title: ‘I don’t feel sorry for myself’: I’m 64 and will be renting for the rest of my life. Is that so bad?
news.summary: “I married a wonderful man with a good income. He left his job due to health issues and suffered a massive stroke at 53.”

news.title: My wife says we can’t afford to retire. I vetoed her $8,000 trip to Italy. We’re in our 60s and have $4 million. Do I keep working?
news.summary: “I worry about healthcare, long-term care, inflation, a long bear market and living to 95.”
